Check manifest and allocation, zero native chunks, empty digest/read and literal counter0.
Delete through the real module and require only the zero counter remains.

Delete the four-byte file and verify complete removal with total3.
Delete its same genuine reference again; verify unchanged peer metadata, exact readable peer bytes and complete remaining keys.

cases.title: Prune only eligible unreferenced captures
cases.failure_hypothesis: Production allocation scanning or later per-file deletion might ignore one eligibility predicate, miss the inclusive boundary, invalidate its outer cursor or reclaim protected bytes.
trace: Capture old protected2-byte and old orphan3-byte files; obtain genuine bracketed allocation times.
Use at most32 waits of5ms to cross the orphan time, capture young4-byte file, and require actual young.createdAt > cutoff before pruning.
Prune with old reference protected at exact orphan timestamp; require only the three-byte orphan removed.
Release the old reference at same cutoff, then advance cutoff to young timestamp; verify exact survivor bytes, keys and totals after each step.
cases.oracle: Genuine protectedAt<=cutoff<youngAt; orphan.createdAt=cutoff. Totals9→6→4→0; first survivors protected[11,12],young[31,32,33,34]; second only young; final only zero counter.
cases.distinctness: T207 transfers KV partitions into SQL and T209 ranks SQL revisions; I211/I215 list/delete R2 objects; C201/C205 buffer typed index groups. Here the actual ActionFileStore first buffers allocation handles then opens deletion lists, enforcing conjunctive live-reference and inclusive-age eligibility with genuine runtime timestamps. Missing witness is BLOCKED, not altered timestamps.

cases.title: Preserve captures through aggregate refusal
cases.failure_hypothesis: An ordinary aggregate refusal could publish orphan rows or perturb earlier captures/accounting, or prevent a later valid exact-capacity capture.
trace: Capture four and three bytes under per-file8 and aggregate8 limits.
Attempt a valid five-byte third capture and require the exact aggregate-limit Error.
Compare complete preexisting native key/value snapshot, independently established metadata/keys, and both original literal public reads.
Delete the first capture and repeat the valid five-byte payload; require exact surviving three-plus-five bytes and complete keys at counter8.
cases.oracle: Before refusal total7; normal five-byte refusal leaves all seven native keys/values unchanged. After deleting four bytes and admitting five, exact total8 with two genuine complete captures.
cases.distinctness: T201 refuses a conditional SQL reservation, T213 reduces synthetic chunk completeness, C202 rolls back typed-index uniqueness changes, and I208 refuses an R2 revision condition. Actual ActionFileStore must refuse a valid payload after hashing but before publishing allocation/chunks and remain usable. No malformed limit or corruption path is tested.
